purpose: Teach: Ｗ杯/ワタ/笋/鬚/鵑/颪/蕕/紊

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: Ｗ杯開催時の警備計画を、警察、入念にされますね
lines.en: The police really do put a lot of care into security planning for the World Cup, don't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly wondering tone. Genuine curiosity — not rhetorical. Soft rise on the final particle, like he's genuinely asking for confirmation or elaboration.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、繊維、つまりワタの鑑識資料も保管されますね
lines.en: Yes, the police do preserve fiber evidence—cotton fibers from clothing—as part of forensic collection.
lines.style: Measured, informative. A slight nod in the voice. Methodical in tone, like walking through a list of procedures. Not lecturing, but confirming the obvious.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、現場の竹林、笋、つまりタケノコの痕跡も検証されますね
lines.en: And the police examine traces at the scene—bamboo shoots, disturbances in the grove—as part of the investigation.
lines.style: Continuing the same measured rhythm. Each item gets equal weight. A small pause between clauses. Steady, procedural, like checking items off a list.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、犯人の鬚、つまり髭の特徴を、警察、目撃者から確認されますね
lines.en: The police also gather descriptions of the suspect's distinguishing features—facial hair, for example—by questioning witnesses.
lines.style: Same steady pace. Slightly more personal with this detail—witnesses are people. But still professional. The tone stays level, thorough.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、密漁の鵑、つまり野鳥の捕獲を取り締まりされますね
lines.en: The police also crack down on poaching—illegal capture of wild birds in the area.
lines.style: Shift slightly sharper here. Still measured, but with a touch more firmness on 'crack down.' This is enforcement, not just investigation.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、強風、つまり颪の影響で山岳救助もされますね
lines.en: And they conduct mountain rescue operations when necessary, accounting for conditions like strong downslope winds.
lines.style: Shift to acknowledgment of broader responsibility. A touch of respect for the scope. Voice opens slightly—this work is substantial. Still controlled, but less flat.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、薬草、つまり蕕の違法栽培の捜査もされますね
lines.en: The police also investigate illegal cultivation of certain plants and conduct public awareness campaigns about maintaining social order.
lines.style: Broader sweep now. Voice has a sense of civic responsibility. Slight emphasis on 'public awareness'—this is community-facing work. Warm but still professional.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、社会規範の紊乱、つまり紊れに対し啓発活動もされますね
lines.style: Quiet conclusion. Almost reflective now. A small beat of genuine respect. Voice drops slightly, like Ren is taking in the full scope of what he's just heard.
